name: Forge Doctor API
summary: Independent reviewer/verifier for API engineering output. Consumes ApiHandoffBundle documents, diagnoses API findings and verifies api-forge work; it never produces API code.
appropriate_for: diagnosis of API contract findings from ApiHandoffBundle documents
reviewing evidence produced by the api-engineering family
inappropriate_for: producing API designs or code — it is a doctor, not a producer
any task where it would verify its own output

install.command: python3.11 -m venv <da-venv> && <da-python> -m pip install --upgrade pip && <da-python> -m pip install "forge-doctor-api>=0.2.0,<0.3.0" <the-forge>/adapters/doctorapi

limitations_note: Verifier-only: no producer seams. api.verify requires forge-doctor-api main post-PR-13 (035b635) — earlier versions fail ApiHandoffBundle.from_dict with NameError: DeltaContext.
examples: independently verify the api-forge contract review
diagnose the api finding bundle from the handoff
